::: {.letter-metadata}
**Date:** Febry 12th 1876  
**From:** Elderfield, Otterbourne, Winchester.’  
**Manuscript:** MS fragment Plymouth and West Devon Area Record Office Acc No 308: 12-2-76
:::

My dear [Mary](people/person_1626.qmd),

So the dear old [Sir John Coleridge](people/person_344.qmd) is gone, except [Aunt Jane](people/person_627.qmd)[^1], I suppose [paper torn off]

[the reverse reads]

the most conscientious of natures, and all throughout guarded and raised by his deep religiousness I always think the tender

---

[^1]: Sir John Taylor Coleridge had died on 11 February.  The sentence probably went to say that now Mary's [father](people/person_1623.qmd) had only his sister Jane Harris surviving among his contemporaries.
